title: Amazon QuickSight SPICE Ingestion Failures
dataSources: MicroStrategy DSS logs (`microstrategy:dsserror`), Cognos audit (`cognos:audit`), BusinessObjects audit (`businessobjects:audit`), Oracle Analytics usage (`oracle:analytics:usage`), ThoughtSpot audit (`thoughtspot:audit`), QuickSight CloudTrail (`aws:cloudtrail`).
app: Enterprise BI server logs (MicroStrategy, Cognos, SAP BusinessObjects, Oracle Analytics, ThoughtSpot) via Universal Forwarder; platform admin APIs and QuickSight CloudTrail via HEC and the Splunk Add-on for AWS.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=aws:cloudtrail eventSource="quicksight.amazonaws.com" eventName="CreateIngestion" OR eventName="UpdateDataSet"
| search errorCode=* OR ingestionStatus="FAILED"
| stats count as failures by requestParameters.dataSetId, errorCode
| sort - failures
description: Detects failed Amazon QuickSight SPICE dataset ingestions from CloudTrail so dashboards backed by SPICE do not silently serve stale imported data.
value: SPICE ingestion failures freeze QuickSight dashboards at the last good import; CloudTrail-based detection catches them without polling each dataset.
implementation: Route QuickSight CloudTrail via the Splunk Add-on for AWS; schedule hourly and alert on ingestion failures for production datasets.
visualization: Table of dataset by failures and error code.
grandmaExplanation: We watch QuickSight's data imports so dashboards do not quietly show old data after a failed refresh.
